Episode 8:
Prema sees Keshav in the balcony and gets irritated. She complains to Dilruba, who decides to take Keshav to task. When Dilruba arrives in the balcony, he sees Koki and does what Keshav did upon seeing Prema. Koki too like Prema complains to Keshav about Dilruba. In the ensuing conversation, Koki ends up challenging Keshav that he has to woo Prema. Will Keshav succeed in the challenge? Watch this episode to find out.
